args.body:
- Brightline Freight's newsletter "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" links to their main article on cold-chain trends for 2026.
- Main article: temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece: cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter (~25% reduction).
args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
